text: Rory Mensah scored an equalizer for Redmond Rovers with a low-chance shot from almost 27 meters, assisted by Kian Coleman after a neat passing move that started from a free kick and included six passes over 20 seconds [#690] [#689]. This goal leveled the match at 1-1, showing how Redmond’s quick and precise passing broke down Ironvale’s deep defense. Before the goal, Redmond had been controlling the ball well with 57% possession and nearly 90% pass accuracy, creating pressure and chances. It was a great example of teamwork and patience paying off for the home side!
